notes.note: Post-battle leader index (R1) comes from 0642.bla: God in party -> k=0, else Mebius -> k=1, else the Mebius-first chain 14,8,15,13,12,11,9,10,6,7,5,4,3,2,1 (k=2 Zero, 3 Taro, 4 Seven, 5 Ultraman, 6 Wing Zero, 7 00, 8 Nu, 9 Zeta, 10 OOO, 11 W, 12 Den-O, 13 RX, 14 Rider 1). So #0.124-133 = k=5..14 (story_123's God-first mapping differs for k=1..9 only; the JP there is identical, so the English is unaffected).
k=11 W: calmer 'oshiete moraou ... doko ni aru?' kept as a firm but level question.
k=12 Den-O (Momotaros): rough 'tte no wa' line.
k=13 RX: 'oshiete morau zo' -> 'You're going to tell us!', matching the God line in #0.119.
Master Gundam: 'wareware jishin' = Regis' own members (the villains) generate the Minus Energy that powers the Cube.

#0.136-150 leader block, same k order (0 God, 1 Mebius ... 12 Den-O #0.148, 14 Rider 1). 'da to!?' -> 'Your own Minus Energy, you say!?'; softer 'datte!?' (#0.137 Mebius, #0.145 Zeta, #0.146 OOO) -> 'What, your own Minus Energy!?'; bare #0.147 (W) without a tag.
Devil Gundam roar; #0.154 is identical JP to #0.97 and reuses story_123's 'Grrooooooaaargh...!!'.
Master Gundam to the heroes: 'kisamara to no battle' = the fight with them woke the Devil Gundam. Rendered 'your battle with us' from his point of view.
'ikase wa sen zo' = he bars the way so they cannot chase the fleeing Devil Gundam; object 'it' restored.

#0.176-190 are explicit per-character branches (labels 'Mebius' are carried over): God, Mebius, Zero, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, OOO, W, Den-O (#0.188 rough), RX, Rider 1 (#0.190 archaic 'doke-i'). 'doke' -> 'Out of my way!!', 'doku n da' -> 'Step aside!!', 'soko wo doku n da' -> 'Step out of the way!!', 'doite kure' -> 'Please, get out of the way!!'.
One sentence cut across #0.191/#0.192; English cut at the matching point ('not a single finger...' / '...shall you lay on it...'). 'It' = the Devil Gundam.
Ankh (speaker 36 in script). Master Gundam exits shielding the Devil Gundam's escape.

#0.196-209 explicit per-character branches: 196 Mebius, 197 Zero, 198 God, 199 Seven, 200 Ultraman, 201 Wing Zero, 202 00, 203 Nu, 204 Zeta (then OOO, W, Den-O #0.207, RX, Rider 1 in story_125). Taro has no slot: if Taro is in the party, Ankh says #0.210 instead. Wording matched to story_125: plain 'sareta ra' -> its standard line, 'sarecha' -> its 'Can't have...' line; #0.196 (Mebius, polite 'kimi ... ne') given the standard line like OOO's 'ne' variant #0.205.
Seven/Ultraman formal word order ('omae ga torikomarete Devil Gundam ni shinka demo sarete wa'); the evolving subject is still the Devil Gundam.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped from 0642.bla: post-battle R1 index (God k=0, Mebius k=1, then Mebius-first chain) for #0.124-150/#0.156-170; #0.176-190 and #0.196-204 are explicit per-character branches, which confirm the rough lines #0.188/#0.207 are Den-O (Momotaros). story_123's note used the pre-battle God-first chain for #0.119-133; harmless there because the JP is identical. No new names or terms.
